reviewed_final_statements.integratedPower_newton_guard_structural: forall (y : Fin 9 -> Real) (i : Fin 9) (k : Nat), k <= 6 -> integratedPower y i k = duplicateH y i k / ((Nat.factorial 9 : Real) * ((9+k).choose k : Real))
reviewed_final_statements.duplicateH_author_guard_structural: forall (y : Fin 9 -> Rat) (i : Fin 9) (k : Nat), k <= 6 -> duplicateH y i k = sum (j : Fin (k+1)), completeH (List.ofFn y) (k-j.val) * y i ^ j.val
reviewed_final_statements.duplicateH_eq_completeH_small: forall {A} [CommRing A] [Algebra Rat A] (y : Fin 9 -> A) (i : Fin 9) (k : Nat), k <= 6 -> duplicateH y i k = completeH (y i :: List.ofFn y) k
reviewed_final_statements.completeH_newton_small: forall {A} [CommRing A] (as : List A) (k : Nat), k <= 5 -> ((k+1 : Nat) : A) * completeH as (k+1) = sum (j : Fin (k+1)), powerSum as (j.val+1) * completeH as (k-j.val)
